description:
The Rigid.PRO CineRig Base quickly and simply attaches to your camera body cage with just a few screws, and elevates it to a cinematic powerhouse!

Rigid.PRO has quickly become the choice of videographers, content creators and filmmakers around the world.

With products for Sony, Nikon, Fujifilm, Canon, Panasonic and more, our wide range appeals to a very large audience.

Self-referrals — using your own affiliate link for personal purchases

Impersonating Rigid.PRO — running ads, social profiles, or websites that imply you are the official brand

Trademark infringement — using "Rigid.PRO", "OMNIA", "CineBack" or our logos in your domain name, social handle, business name, or app

Posting on Wikipedia, news sites, or comment threads with the sole purpose of inserting affiliate links

5. Commissions and Payment

When you refer a customer who completes a purchase on our website, you will earn a commission based on the published Commission structure. Commission is calculated on the order subtotal and does not include taxes, shipping, duties, or any extra fees.

To receive payment you must specify your payment details under Settings. The payment schedule is shown on the Affiliate Guide page.

Payments are made only on successfully completed transactions. The Program is subject to a fair-use policy which entitles us to review every referral order. The status of each commission is shown on the Commission tab; paid commissions appear on the Payment tab. Transactions resulting in chargebacks, refunds, returns, or fraud will not be paid out, and any commission already paid for such orders may be reversed or deducted from future payments.

We reserve the right to withhold or reverse commissions on orders we reasonably believe were generated through prohibited activities listed in Section 4.

6. Marketing Materials

We may share promotional media — banners, logos, product photography, lifestyle imagery, and collection promotions — through the Marketing Tool tab. You may download these assets or copy the HTML embed code to share on permitted affiliate channels.

You may not modify our logos, alter our trademarks, edit product photography in a misleading way, or use our creative in any prohibited channel listed in Section 4.

7. Network / Downline Affiliates

If the Network tab is activated, you may invite others to become downline affiliates. When a downline affiliate generates an order, the upline affiliate also earns a network commission based on our settings.

To invite other affiliates, share your network link. Anyone who clicks the link and signs up becomes your downline affiliate.

Downline affiliates are bound by the same terms — including the prohibitions in Section 4. You are responsible for ensuring affiliates you invite understand and comply with these terms.

8. Cookies and Tracking

We use a cookie to track customers who click your link, so they need to allow cookies for us to track them.

If a customer disallows cookies or clears their cookies, we cannot track them and cannot pay commission on their activity.

The cookie duration is shown on the Affiliate registration form. Tracking begins when the customer clicks your affiliate link or uses your coupon. Within the cookie window, every order placed by that customer on our website automatically results in a commission to you (no further click required).

9. Disclosure Requirements

You must clearly disclose your affiliate relationship with Rigid.PRO whenever you promote our products. This is a legal requirement under the US FTC Endorsement Guides, Australian Consumer Law (ACCC), UK ASA / CMA, and EU consumer-protection regulations.

Acceptable disclosures include "#ad", "#affiliate", "Affiliate link", or a clear statement such as "I earn a commission if you purchase through this link". Disclosures must be conspicuous and not buried in hashtags or hidden in long captions.

11. Termination

Go forward and refer.
